{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: revenue == 999999.99
qa_mask = df['revenue_float'] == 999999.99
qa_count = qa_mask.sum()
print(f'QA orders found: {qa_count}')

# Identify refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'
refunded_count = refunded_mask.sum()
print(f'Refunded orders found: {refunded_count}')

# Filter out QA and refunded orders
filtered_df = df[~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask]
print(f'Rows after filtering: {filtered_df.shape[0]} out of 900')

# Raw conversion rate by channel
raw_conv = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print('Raw conversion rate by channel:')
print(raw_conv)

# Stratified conversion rate: convert to float for clarity
stratified_conv = filtered_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['converted'].mean().unstack(fill_value=0)
print('Stratified conversion rate by channel and segment:')
print(stratified_conv)

# Segment sizes in filtered dataset
segment_counts = filtered_df['customer_segment'].value_counts()
print('Segment sizes in filtered dataset:')
print(segment_counts)

# Compute weighted conversion rate for each channel
weighted_conv = {}
total_count = segment_counts.sum()

for channel in ['email', 'paid_search']:
    weighted_sum = 0
    for seg in segment_counts.index:
        conv_rate = stratified_conv.loc[channel, seg]
        weight = segment_counts[seg] / total_count
        weighted_sum += conv_rate * weight
    weighted_conv[channel] = weighted_sum

weighted_conv_series = pd.Series(weighted_conv)
print('Weighted conversion rate (stratified by segment):')
print(weighted_conv_series)

# Compute difference
diff = weighted_conv_series['email'] - weighted_conv_series['paid_search']
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.6f}')"}
